## Determinism (test/projection.test.mjs, A8 / B1-8; test/factory.test.mjs for multi)

The baseline (and, in test/factory.test.mjs, the multi projection) is built four times inside the test — plain; a seeded shuffle of every input list plus reversed adapter order; a second seed; reversed adapter order alone — and every hashed file is compared byte for byte; the roots are equal. `witness.json` (timestamps, host, seeds) lives outside the digest and differs by design.

## What these projections do not claim

Every node and relation record is `basis: observed`. Derived facts, when present, live in `derived/` with `basis: derived`, `trvm_derivation: false` and a derivation per fact replayed by the independent checker; they never enter the observed projection root. The `sem-` under `world/` is WRL's seal of the SEMANTIC STATEMENT world of the projection (D-041 §8), computed by WRL from the submitted artifact and stored outside the projection root; it is not a registry write and not a TRVM derivation (the ruleset id in the manifest binds the rule program, not an evaluation). Fault rows are source facts, not verdicts. The G0-D certificate under `certificate/` certifies RECONSTRUCTION IDENTITY only (D-054): under these pinned sources, schemas, adapters, rule-program id and canonical-byte rules the directory reconstructs to this root; it does not say any claim is true, any evidence sufficient, any state promoted, any registry written or any derivation TRVM's, and possession of its `vclaim-` confers no authority.
